item.text: The current filters call Python’s built-ins directly and aren’t environment filters. I’ll add independent feature detection for Jinja’s `do_min` and `do_max`, forward keyword arguments when that filter exists, and preserve the built-in behavior when no keywords are given. I’ll also cover the Jinja attribute options and the unsupported-keyword error in the existing unit tests.

The code now detects `do_min` and `do_max` separately. Keyword calls use the matching Jinja filter; older Jinja versions raise the requested error, while calls without keywords retain Python’s built-in behavior. I’ve updated the unit cases to pass the Jinja environment required by the decorators and added coverage for attributes, case sensitivity, and fallback behavior.
